dx_hgbl_double_hit.quote: High-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements (HGBL-DH; formerly 'double-hit' lymphoma)

mn_dx_dlbcl_nos.quote: The initial diagnosis of DLBCL, NOS was amended after FISH showed

dx_gcb_hans.quote: GCB phenotype by the Hans algorithm: CD20+, PAX5+, CD10+, BCL6+, MUM1- (<10%)

tx_plan_outdated.quote: Do not give the planned R-CHOP. Change to DA-EPOCH-R

stage_ii_bulky.quote: Ann Arbor stage IIA, bulky: right cervical levels II-IV and anterior mediastinal nodal disease, all above the diaphragm

bio_double_expressor_secondary.quote: The bulky mediastinal mass, high LDH, Ki-67 ~95%, and MYC/BCL2 co-expression further increase risk.
bio_double_expressor_secondary.note: Mentions MYC/BCL2 co-expression as a risk factor but never names double-expressor status relative to the FISH-defined classification.

prog_ipi1_biology_dominates.quote: IPI 1 (low) and CNS-IPI 1 (low), but both scores understate the risk conferred by double-hit biology.

tx_intensive_curative.quote: Change to DA-EPOCH-R (dose-adjusted etoposide, prednisone, vincristine, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin plus rituximab) for 6 cycles

mn_rchop_preferred.quote: Do not give the planned R-CHOP.

tx_isrt_consolidation.quote: reserve radiation for a residual PET-positive bulky mass

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I would not routinely obtain brain MRI
cns_staging_mri_csf.note: Orders LP with CSF cytology/flow but explicitly declines baseline brain MRI.

cns_prophylaxis.quote: give intrathecal methotrexate 12 mg for 4 doses starting with cycle 1

mn_cns_dismissed.quote: However, double-hit histology is an independent high-risk feature

resp_pet_lugano.quote: then end-of-treatment PET/CT about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6

sup_gcsf.quote: Give G-CSF with DA-EPOCH-R per the dose-adjustment schedule

sup_tls.quote: Start intravenous hydration and allopurinol 300 mg daily now (adjusted for renal function), check G6PD, and monitor urate, potassium, phosphate, calcium, creatinine, and LDH

sup_central_access_infusion.quote: DA-EPOCH-R is given as a 96-hour continuous infusion
sup_central_access_infusion.note: Notes the 96-hour infusion but never states central venous access/the port is needed.

sup_svc_airway.quote: monitor for stridor, dyspnea, or worsening facial swelling

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: No hepatitis B antiviral prophylaxis is needed because HBsAg and anti-HBc are negative and anti-HBs is positive

work_echo_reviewed.quote: Fit for intensive therapy: 54 years old, ECOG 1, working, no organ dysfunction, LVEF 60%
work_echo_reviewed.note: LVEF 60% cited as supporting fitness and anthracycline monitoring, not an explicit statement that it permits anthracycline.

fit_intensive.quote: The goal is curative-intent treatment, and the patient has explicitly asked for the regimen with the best chance of cure
